title.zh: 所得税（飞机投资管理人优惠税率）（规定活动）条例 2008
title.en: Income Tax (Concessionary Rate of Tax for Aircraft Investment Manager) (Prescribed Activities) Regulations 2008

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. These Regulations may be cited as the Income Tax (Concessionary Rate of Tax for Aircraft Investment Manager) (Prescribed Activities) Regulations 2008 and shall be deemed to have come into operation on 1st March 2007.

3. For the purposes of section 43Z(1)(b) of the Act, the prescribed services or activities shall be the services or activities specified in the Schedule and which are carried out by an approved aircraft investment manager.

THE SCHEDULE
Regulation 3
Prescribed Services or Activities
1. Provision of investment advisory services for and to an approved aircraft leasing company.
